protocol_findings.name: Original evaluated Selector receipt
protocol_findings.implemented: A private explicit evaluated profile consumes the opaque four-cut original T/B context; it requires changed Candidate plus actual Evaluation::NoUpdate, original complete signatures and actor/controller separation. It signs the actual retained Cell Selection through the original journal, producing a five-cut result with an evaluated-specific digest domain.
must_preserve: Separate legacy TrainingNoUpdate profile and digest domain.
Same original T/B signatures, scope/trust/objective binding and live client rereads.
Local/evaluated predecessor reads before final actual Cell observation and final journal reread.
Recovered context is permanently Readback; FreshCreate cannot promote it or renew original deadlines.
Selection source/profile matching and immutable same-prefix checks.
protocol_findings.not_established: No ordinary product producer or independent process enrollment is demonstrated. create/recover/attest product callers are empty.

protocol_findings.name: Original evaluated Selector readback service
protocol_findings.implemented: The consuming factory retains the same original Selector owner, published Cell and original finite T/B clients. The bounded existing read-only evidence wire performs original journal/live T/B/Cell reads and returns the exact old signature, with request identity/correlation and before/after binding checks.
must_preserve: Consume self; no replacement key, journal or fabricated result constructor.
At most four concurrent service permits and 128 exchanges; same original peer channel and bounded timeout.
Private opaque result/context fields and immutable binding checks.
Recovery remains read-only and current predecessor withdrawal remains a refusal.
protocol_findings.not_established: The actual serve/transfer product caller sets remain empty. Same-process fixture transport is not a daemon deployment.

protocol_findings.name: Original evaluated C receipt
protocol_findings.implemented: The original Observer journal binds the sealed five-cut S result. It requires live original T/B/S readbacks and an actual completed retained-model Source/Cell observation, then signs a six-cut result. A mere S receipt or unused publication is insufficient.
must_preserve: Only RetainedModelNextUse is accepted by the evaluated receipt domain.
Distinct original T/B/S actor/controller separation from Observer.
T/B/S reread before final actual Source/Cell observation, final physical journal bytes, and authentication.
Recovered attestation entry delegates to readback; missing recovered journal cannot claim or sign.
The legacy profile explicitly rejects the evaluated five-cut because it lacks original B readback.
protocol_findings.not_established: No C task is executed or authorized by this receipt owner itself. Its new create/recover/attest/readback ordinary product caller sets remain empty.

protocol_findings.name: Independent measurement intake V2
protocol_findings.implemented: An explicit V2 entry accepts the independently signed Observer's nonzero Outcome measurement-support digest while Decision support remains bound to the actual Source publication and NDU snapshot. V1 still requires Source-publication Outcome support. Both share original actor/controller authentication, same ledger/source joins, terminal time/watermark checks, exact partial-append/replay behavior, active-Decision checks and final Source reread.
must_preserve: Do not reinterpret V1 or previously frozen Dataset inclusion contracts.
Verify both signed messages before the first append.
Propensity remains exactly ONE for this supported deterministic original profile.
V2 does not authorize freezing a Dataset or generating a measurement.
protocol_findings.not_established: The V2 ordinary product caller set is empty; a nonzero signed digest does not prove empirical independence, measurement truth, availability or causal identification.
